column1: And I'm Professor Video. Synths first, then video. Mostly video now. Press START and we'll patch... we'll begin.
column2: ແລະ ຂ້ອຍຄື ອາຈານ Video. synth ກ່ອນ ແລ້ວຈຶ່ງວິດີໂອ. ດຽວນີ້ ສ່ວນຫຼາຍແມ່ນວິດີໂອ. ກົດ START ແລ້ວພວກເຮົາຈະຕໍ່ສາຍ... ຈະເລີ່ມ.
ເປີດ OUTPUT

column1: Skapi, the screen is empty. Don't keep them waiting. Open MENU and make OUTPUT OFF say OUTPUT ON. Aide!
column2: Skapi, ໜ້າຈໍຫວ່າງເປົ່າ. ຢ່າໃຫ້ເຂົາລໍຖ້າ. ເປີດ ເມນູ ແລ້ວປ່ຽນ OUTPUT OFF ເປັນ OUTPUT ON. ໄວໆ!

column1: Lesson one: nothing comes out until you patch the oscillator to the... the OUTPUT. It's video. I know.
column2: ບົດທີໜຶ່ງ: ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງອອກມາ ຈົນກວ່າເຈົ້າຕໍ່ oscillator ໃສ່... ໃສ່ OUTPUT. ມັນແມ່ນວິດີໂອ. ຂ້ອຍຮູ້.
ນຳຄລິບເຂົ້າມາ

column1: Now a picture. Press I and pick a clip from your computer. No clip? SHOW ME, and I lend you one of mine.
column2: ດຽວນີ້ ຮູບ. ກົດ I ແລ້ວເລືອກຄລິບ ຈາກຄອມຂອງເຈົ້າ. ບໍ່ມີຄລິບບໍ? SHOW ME ຂ້ອຍຈະໃຫ້ຢືມອັນໜຶ່ງ.

column1: Every clip becomes a cue in the playlist. Like loading a sample. A sample with pictures in it.
column2: ທຸກຄລິບ ກາຍເປັນ cue ໃນ playlist. ຄືກັບໂຫຼດ sample. sample ທີ່ມີຮູບຢູ່ໃນ.
ເອົາຂຶ້ນສົດ

column1: Your clip waits in the playlist. Select it, then TAKE. Or Enter. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: ຄລິບຂອງເຈົ້າ ລໍຢູ່ໃນ playlist. ເລືອກມັນ ແລ້ວ TAKE. ຫຼື Enter. ຜູ້ຄວບຄຸມທີ່ໝັ້ນໃຈ ກົດ Enter.

column1: TAKE is the envelope trigger. The, ah, the GO button. Same thing, it just has pictures in it.
column2: TAKE ຄືໄກຂອງ envelope. ເອີ... ປຸ່ມ GO. ອັນດຽວກັນ ພຽງແຕ່ມີຮູບ.
ກຽມອັນຕໍ່ໄປ

column1: Click another cue. It waits, ready, until you say. Only one cue? Import another, or SHOW ME.
column2: ຄລິກ cue ອື່ນ. ມັນລໍຖ້າ ພ້ອມ ຈົນກວ່າເຈົ້າສັ່ງ. ມີ cue ດຽວບໍ? ນຳເຂົ້າອີກອັນ ຫຼື SHOW ME.

column1: Selecting is not playing. The selected one is the next note in the sequence. The next CUE.
column2: ເລືອກ ບໍ່ແມ່ນ ຫຼິ້ນ. ອັນທີ່ເລືອກ ຄືໂນດຕໍ່ໄປ ໃນລຳດັບ. CUE ຕໍ່ໄປ.
CROSSFADE ໄປຫາມັນ

column1: Cuts are for amateurs. In the inspector, press + on transition, so it shows a time, not deck. Then TAKE.
column2: ຕັດກົງ ສຳລັບມືໃໝ່. ໃນ inspector ກົດ + ທີ່ transition ຈົນມັນສະແດງເວລາ ບໍ່ແມ່ນ deck. ແລ້ວ TAKE.

column1: A crossfade! Portamento, but for pictures. Any time will do. A few more presses and it's a second. Then TAKE.
column2: Crossfade! portamento ແຕ່ສຳລັບຮູບ. ເວລາໃດກໍງາມ. ກົດອີກຈັກເທື່ອ ກໍເປັນໜຶ່ງວິນາທີ. ແລ້ວ TAKE.
ລ້າງໜ້າຈໍ

column1: Something goes wrong on stage? Press BLACK, or B. The picture goes. The show keeps running underneath.
column2: ມີຫຍັງຜິດ ເທິງເວທີບໍ? ກົດ BLACK ຫຼື B. ຮູບຫາຍໄປ. ໂຊຍັງແລ່ນຢູ່ຂ້າງລຸ່ມ.

column1: Nothing is lost. Press B again and it comes back. Like the mute on a mixer. Very calming.
column2: ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງເສຍ. ກົດ B ອີກ ມັນກັບມາ. ຄືປຸ່ມ mute ເທິງ mixer. ສະຫງົບຫຼາຍ.
ບັນທຶກໂຊ

column1: Now save. Ctrl+S, or SAVE. Some programs lose your work and then blame you. I would never.
column2: ດຽວນີ້ ບັນທຶກ. Ctrl+S ຫຼື ບັນທຶກ. ບາງໂປຣແກຣມ ເຮັດວຽກເຈົ້າເສຍ ແລ້ວໂທດເຈົ້າ. ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ເຄີຍ.

column1: Save your patch. Your SHOW. Show. This practice one lives in Deckboy's own folder; yours is safe.
column2: ບັນທຶກ patch ຂອງເຈົ້າ. ໂຊຂອງເຈົ້າ. ໂຊ. ອັນທົດລອງນີ້ ຢູ່ໃນໂຟນເດີ Deckboy; ອັນຂອງເຈົ້າ ປອດໄພ.
ນັ້ນແມ່ນໂຊ

column1: That's a show! Output, cue, TAKE, crossfade, BLACK, save. Nazdrave, skapi. Rakia is on me.
column2: ນັ້ນແມ່ນໂຊ! Output, cue, TAKE, crossfade, BLACK, ບັນທຶກ. Nazdrave, skapi. Rakia ຂ້ອຍລ້ຽງ. ແຮງກວ່າເຫຼົ້າລາວ ລະວັງເດີ້.

column1: Class dismissed. The example shows teach layers, titles and effects. MENU > LEARN THE BASICS runs this again.
column2: ຈົບບົດ. ໂຊຕົວຢ່າງ ສອນ layer, ຫົວຂໍ້ ແລະ effect. ເມນູ > LEARN THE BASICS ຫຼິ້ນບົດນີ້ອີກ.
*ສ່າຍຫົວ* ນັ້ນໝາຍຄວາມວ່າ ແມ່ນ. ແຊບ!
ດີເລີດ! ສາຍສັນຍານງາມ.

column1: Mm. I knew you had it in you.
column2: ອືມ. ຂ້ອຍຮູ້ວ່າເຈົ້າເຮັດໄດ້.

column1: Yes! Have a gold star. It's a dot.
column2: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ! ເອົາດາວຄຳໄປ. ມັນເປັນຈຸດ.

column1: Ready for the next step? *nods* ...That means no, skapi. The glowing one. It is glowing for you.
column2: ພ້ອມສຳລັບຂັ້ນຕໍ່ໄປບໍ? *ພະຍັກໜ້າ* ...ຢູ່ Bulgaria ນັ້ນແມ່ນ ບໍ່ skapi. ອັນທີ່ເຫຼື້ອມ. ມັນເຫຼື້ອມໃຫ້ເຈົ້າ.

column1: You've clicked everything but the glowing one. Even my oscillators find the glowing one.
column2: ເຈົ້າຄລິກທຸກອັນ ຍົກເວັ້ນອັນທີ່ເຫຼື້ອມ. ແມ່ນແຕ່ oscillator ຂອງຂ້ອຍ ຍັງຊອກພົບອັນທີ່ເຫຼື້ອມ.

column1: stop playback first - the lesson cannot hand a running show back as it was
column2: ຢຸດການຫຼິ້ນກ່ອນ - ບົດຮຽນ ສົ່ງໂຊທີ່ກຳລັງແລ່ນ ຄືນຄືເກົ່າບໍ່ໄດ້

column1: choose RECOVER or KEEP SAVED first
column2: ເລືອກ RECOVER ຫຼື KEEP SAVED ກ່ອນ

column1: your show could not be saved, so the lesson has not started. Save it (SAVE AS) and try again
column2: ບັນທຶກໂຊຂອງເຈົ້າບໍ່ໄດ້ ບົດຮຽນຈຶ່ງຍັງບໍ່ເລີ່ມ. ບັນທຶກມັນ (ບັນທຶກເປັນ) ແລ້ວລອງໃໝ່

column1: the practice show would not open
column2: ເປີດໂຊທົດລອງບໍ່ໄດ້

column1: could not start the practice show
column2: ເລີ່ມໂຊທົດລອງບໍ່ໄດ້

column1: learn the basics: Esc leaves, and it picks up here next time
column2: learn the basics: Esc ອອກ ເທື່ອໜ້າ ສືບຕໍ່ຈາກນີ້

column1: that's the basics - MENU > LESSONS has part two
column2: ພື້ນຖານມີເທົ່ານີ້ - ເມນູ > LESSONS ມີພາກສອງ

column1: tour paused - LEARN THE BASICS picks up where you left off
column2: ພັກໄວ້ - LEARN THE BASICS ສືບຕໍ່ຈາກບ່ອນທີ່ເຈົ້າຢຸດ

column1: Mirrored screens, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: ໜ້າຈໍສະທ້ອນກັນ skapi. ກົດປຸ່ມໃດກໍໄດ້ ຫຼື ຄລິກ ແລ້ວ Dr. Pixel ຈະຄືນໃຫ້.

column1: Wrong screen, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: ຜິດໜ້າຈໍ skapi. ກົດປຸ່ມໃດກໍໄດ້ ຫຼື ຄລິກ ແລ້ວ Dr. Pixel ຈະຄືນໃຫ້.

column1: The other screen went away, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: ໜ້າຈໍອີກອັນ ຫາຍໄປ skapi. ກົດປຸ່ມໃດກໍໄດ້ ຫຼື ຄລິກ ແລ້ວ Dr. Pixel ຈະຄືນໃຫ້.

column1: One screen, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: ໜ້າຈໍດຽວ skapi. ກົດປຸ່ມໃດກໍໄດ້ ຫຼື ຄລິກ ແລ້ວ Dr. Pixel ຈະຄືນໃຫ້.

column1: The other screen went away, skapi, so the picture came back to this one. I put it in a little window, behind. Plug it back in and the picture goes back on it.
column2: ໜ້າຈໍອີກອັນ ຫາຍໄປ skapi ຮູບຈຶ່ງກັບມາຈໍນີ້. ຂ້ອຍໃສ່ມັນໃນໜ້າຕ່າງນ້ອຍ ຢູ່ທາງຫຼັງ. ສຽບຄືນ ແລ້ວຮູບຈະກັບໄປ.

column1: It ate the desk, skapi. One screen, so the output took all of it. I put it in a little window, behind. A real show gets a second screen.
column2: ມັນກິນໂຕະແລ້ວ skapi. ໜ້າຈໍດຽວ output ຈຶ່ງເອົາໄປໝົດ. ຂ້ອຍໃສ່ມັນໃນໜ້າຕ່າງນ້ອຍ ຢູ່ທາງຫຼັງ. ໂຊແທ້ ມີໜ້າຈໍທີສອງ.
ມັນກິນໂຕະ

column1: There. The button that says OUTPUT OFF. Make it say ON, skapi.
column2: ນັ້ນ. ປຸ່ມທີ່ຂຽນ OUTPUT OFF. ເຮັດໃຫ້ມັນເປັນ ON skapi.

column1: Nothing is live to fade from, skapi. TAKE one cue first, then pick the other and give it a time.
column2: ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງສົດ ໃຫ້ຈາງອອກ skapi. TAKE cue ໜຶ່ງກ່ອນ ແລ້ວເລືອກອີກອັນ ແລະ ໃຫ້ເວລາ.

column1: That was a cut, skapi. Fast, but not a crossfade. Pick the other cue, press + on transition, then TAKE.
column2: ນັ້ນແມ່ນຕັດກົງ skapi. ໄວ ແຕ່ບໍ່ແມ່ນ crossfade. ເລືອກ cue ອີກອັນ ກົດ + ທີ່ transition ແລ້ວ TAKE.

column1: A feedback loop! Output patched straight back into the desk. Happens to the best of us. Mostly to me. 1983. We don't talk about 1983.
column2: ວົງ feedback! Output ຕໍ່ກັບເຂົ້າໂຕະ. ເກີດກັບຄົນເກັ່ງທີ່ສຸດ. ສ່ວນຫຼາຍແມ່ນຂ້ອຍ. 1983. ພວກເຮົາບໍ່ເວົ້າເຖິງ 1983.

column1: No more rakia. The rat has a problem.
column2: ໝົດ rakia ແລ້ວ. ໜູມີບັນຫາ.

column1: Nazdrave, skapi! Baba's rakia, from Belogradchik. One glass, for the lesson.
column2: Nazdrave, skapi! Rakia ຂອງແມ່ຕູ້ ຈາກ Belogradchik. ໜຶ່ງຈອກ ສຳລັບບົດຮຽນ. ແລ້ວເບຍລາວເຢັນໆ ໜຶ່ງຈອກ.

column1: Is this... is this allowed during a tutorial?
column2: ອັນນີ້... ອັນນີ້ ອະນຸຍາດ ໃນບົດຮຽນບໍ?
*ສ່າຍຫົວ* ໝາຍຄວາມວ່າ ອີກຈອກ.

column1: I love you all. I love the oscillator. I love the OUTPUT. It's video. I know. I KNOW.
column2: ຂ້ອຍຮັກພວກເຈົ້າທຸກຄົນ. ຂ້ອຍຮັກ oscillator. ຂ້ອຍຮັກ OUTPUT. ມັນແມ່ນວິດີໂອ. ຂ້ອຍຮູ້. ຂ້ອຍຮູ້!

column1: ...and the rat took the rakia. Every time, skapi. Every single time.
column2: ...ແລ້ວໜູ ເອົາ rakia ໄປ. ທຸກເທື່ອ skapi. ທຸກເທື່ອ.

column1: Was that a rat? In a hat? With a pizza?
column2: ນັ້ນແມ່ນໜູບໍ? ໃສ່ໝວກ? ຖືພິດຊ່າ?

column1: Stop that. I am a serious man.
column2: ຢຸດ. ຂ້ອຍເປັນຄົນຈິງຈັງ.

column1: Do not tell Dr. Pixel about this.
column2: ຢ່າບອກ Dr. Pixel ເລື່ອງນີ້.

column1: This never happened. Back to the patch bay.
column2: ເລື່ອງນີ້ບໍ່ເຄີຍເກີດ. ກັບໄປ patch bay.

column1: It was the eighties. Everyone had a bow tie.
column2: ຍຸກແປດສິບ. ທຸກຄົນມີໂບຜູກຄໍ.
ລາຍການບົດຮຽນ
ເປີດໂຊຕົວຢ່າງ
ອອກ (Esc)
ໂຊອອກເດີນທາງ

column1: CHECK a show before it travels, fix what it finds, and bundle it with its media.
column2: CHECK ກ່ອນເດີນທາງ ແກ້ສິ່ງທີ່ມັນພົບ ແລ້ວ BUNDLE ພ້ອມສື່ຂອງມັນ.
Effect, oscillator ແລະ ສີ

column1: An effect, a ~ on its knob, and the colour picker.
column2: effect ໜຶ່ງ, ~ ເທິງປຸ່ມຂອງມັນ ແລະ ຕົວເລືອກສີ.

column1: The art school crit, with Mr. Salty
column2: ການວິຈານທີ່ໂຮງຮຽນສິລະປະ ກັບ Mr. Salty

column1: The magic show, with Turnip Top

column2: BLACK ທຽບກັບ PANIC ແລະ ການເອົາໂຊຄືນ.

column1: The cooking show, with Chef Bork

column1: Capture a look on a DASH button, change everything, and get it back with one press.
column2: ເກັບພາບໄວ້ໃນປຸ່ມ DASH ປ່ຽນທຸກຢ່າງ ແລ້ວເອົາຄືນດ້ວຍຄລິກດຽວ.
Transition

column2: ແບບຫຼັງ crossfade: iris, shatter ແລະ ເວລາຂອງມັນ.

column1: The space-opera trailer, with Optimus Primetime
column2: ຕົວຢ່າງໜັງອະວະກາດ ກັບ Optimus Primetime
ສຽງ

column1: An audio effect on a cue, a bend that damages it beautifully, and where the patch lives.
column2: effect ສຽງ ເທິງ cue, bend ທີ່ທຳລາຍມັນ ຢ່າງງາມ ແລະ ບ່ອນທີ່ patch ຢູ່.

column1: The robot DJs, with Deft Funk
column2: DJ ຫຸ່ນຍົນ ກັບ Deft Funk

column2: Waveform, vectorscope ແລະ ສີປອມ: ແສງແທ້ ຫຼື ພຽງແຈ້ງເກີນ?

column1: The Signal Files: is the glow on the horizon a craft?
column2: ແຟ້ມສັນຍານ: ແສງເທິງຂອບຟ້າ ແມ່ນຍານບໍ?
ອອກນອກອາຄານ

column1: Where NDI, SDI and ST 2110 live, and NDI switched on where this computer has it.
column2: NDI, SDI ແລະ ST 2110 ຢູ່ໃສ ແລະ ເປີດ NDI ບ່ອນທີ່ເຄື່ອງນີ້ມີ.

column2: ເວັບແຄມ ເປັນຕົວຄວບຄຸມ ເປັນເກມ. ຫ້າຮອບ ຄະແນນສູງສຸດ.
ເຄື່ອງມືຖື ແລະ ແມງໄມ້
Multiview

column1: Windows, the ... menu, what each one shows, layouts, and tally.
column2: ໜ້າຕ່າງ ເມນູ ... ແຕ່ລະອັນສະແດງຫຍັງ layout ແລະ tally.

column2: ຄວາມລັບເທິງຍານອະວະກາດ Cathode ກັບ Lt. Haila ແລະ Ensign Jinkley

column1: DR. PIXEL: Two playlists: Deckboy becomes SUPER DECKBOY. It earned it, skapi.
column2: DR. PIXEL: ສອງ playlist: Deckboy ກາຍເປັນ SUPER DECKBOY. ສົມຄວນແລ້ວ skapi.

column1: PROF. VIDEO: It evolved! My oscillators never got a fanfare.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: ມັນວິວັດແລ້ວ! oscillator ຂອງຂ້ອຍ ບໍ່ເຄີຍໄດ້ສຽງແຕດັ່ງນີ້.

column1: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY! Every show deserves one. Bravo.
column2: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY! ທຸກໂຊສົມຄວນໄດ້. ແຊບ!

column1: PROF. VIDEO: The power-up! More playlists, more layers, more super.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: ເພີ່ມພະລັງ! playlist ຫຼາຍຂຶ້ນ, layer ຫຼາຍຂຶ້ນ, super ຫຼາຍຂຶ້ນ.

column1: Intro video (left on the office PC)
column2: ວິດີໂອເປີດໂຊ (ລືມໄວ້ໃນຄອມຫ້ອງການ)
ເທິງທາງ

column1: A show you built here, skapi, running on a laptop somewhere else tonight. Press START.
column2: ໂຊທີ່ເຈົ້າເຮັດຢູ່ນີ້ skapi ຄືນນີ້ແລ່ນ ເທິງແລັບທັອບ ບ່ອນອື່ນ. ກົດ START.

column1: Before it travels: check it, fix it, bundle it.
column2: ກ່ອນເດີນທາງ: ກວດ, ແກ້, ຫໍ່.

column1: See CHECK in the top bar? It only appears when something is wrong. Press it.
column2: ເຫັນ CHECK ຢູ່ແຖບເທິງບໍ? ມັນປາກົດ ເມື່ອມີຫຍັງຜິດເທົ່ານັ້ນ. ຄລິກມັນ.

column1: It lists everything a show would trip over: missing files, empty cues, unreachable outputs.
column2: ມັນລຽງທຸກສິ່ງ ທີ່ຈະເຮັດໃຫ້ໂຊສະດຸດ: ໄຟລ໌ຂາດ, cue ຫວ່າງ, output ບໍ່ໄດ້ຕໍ່.
ແກ້ມັນ

column1: The intro video is on another computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.
column2: ວິດີໂອເປີດໂຊ ຢູ່ໃນຄອມອື່ນ. ເລືອກມັນ ແລ້ວລຶບ ຫຼື RELINK ຖ້າເຈົ້າມີໄຟລ໌ນຳ.

column1: Fix it at home, where it is easy. Not at the venue, where it is not.
column2: ແກ້ຢູ່ເຮືອນ ຢູ່ນັ້ນງ່າຍ. ບໍ່ແມ່ນຢູ່ສະຖານທີ່ ຢູ່ນັ້ນບໍ່ງ່າຍ.
ຫໍ່ມັນ

column1: Press BUNDLE and choose where: a USB stick, a shared folder. The show and all its media, together.
column2: ກົດ BUNDLE ແລ້ວເລືອກບ່ອນ: USB, ໂຟນເດີແບ່ງປັນ. ໂຊ ແລະ ສື່ທັງໝົດ ໄປນຳກັນ.

column1: The copy finds its media beside it, wherever the folder goes.
column2: ສຳເນົາ ພົບສື່ຂອງມັນ ຢູ່ຂ້າງໆ ໂຟນເດີໄປໃສກໍຕາມ.
ເດີນທາງປອດໄພ

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other machine, open the bundle's show: everything is where it should be.
column2: ກວດແລ້ວ ແກ້ແລ້ວ ຫໍ່ແລ້ວ. ໃນເຄື່ອງອື່ນ ເປີດໂຊທີ່ຫໍ່: ທຸກຢ່າງຢູ່ບ່ອນ.

column1: A show file is only text, so it travels light. The media is the heavy part.
column2: ໄຟລ໌ໂຊ ເປັນພຽງຂໍ້ຄວາມ ເດີນທາງເບົາ. ທີ່ໜັກ ຄືສື່.
ຜົນງານນັກຮຽນ ເລກ 4 (ບໍ່ມີຊື່)
ການວິຈານ

column1: An art school, skapi. One student, one picture, one critic who has seen it all. Press START.
column2: ໂຮງຮຽນສິລະປະ skapi. ນັກຮຽນຄົນໜຶ່ງ ຮູບໜຶ່ງ ນັກວິຈານ ທີ່ເຫັນມາໝົດແລ້ວ. ກົດ START.

column1: Effects change a picture; an oscillator keeps changing it. The critic only likes the second kind.
column2: Effect ປ່ຽນຮູບ; oscillator ປ່ຽນມັນຕໍ່ໄປເລື້ອຍໆ. ນັກວິຈານມັກແຕ່ແບບທີສອງ.

column1: A grey square on beige. I have seen this at every graduate show since 1987.
column2: ສີ່ຫຼ່ຽມສີເທົາ ເທິງພື້ນຄີມ. ລາວເຫັນມັນ ທຸກງານຈົບການສຶກສາ ຕັ້ງແຕ່ 1987.
EFFECT ໜຶ່ງ

column1: In the inspector's EFFECTS section, + adds one. Edges is a good start: it draws the outlines.
column2: ໃນສ່ວນ EFFECTS ຂອງ inspector, + ເພີ່ມອັນໜຶ່ງ. Edges ເປັນການເລີ່ມທີ່ດີ: ມັນແຕ້ມເສັ້ນ.

column1: There are dozens. Every one runs on the CPU in a few milliseconds. Mostly.
column2: ມີຫຼາຍສິບອັນ. ແຕ່ລະອັນແລ່ນເທິງ CPU ໃນບໍ່ເທົ່າໃດມິລລິວິນາທີ. ສ່ວນຫຼາຍ.

column1: Take a risk! Bad art is fine. Boring art is a crime.
column2: ກ້າເສຍ! ສິລະປະບໍ່ດີ ກໍດີ. ສິລະປະໜ້າເບື່ອ ແມ່ນອາຊະຍາກຳ.
~ ເທິງປຸ່ມ

column1: Every control with a ~ beside it can follow an oscillator. Press one. The knob starts to breathe.
column2: ການຄວບຄຸມໃດ ທີ່ມີ ~ ຢູ່ຂ້າງ ຕາມ oscillator ໄດ້. ຄລິກອັນໜຶ່ງ. ປຸ່ມເລີ່ມຫາຍໃຈ.

column1: A low-frequency oscillator: slow, so the eye can follow it. A quarter of a hertz is a four-second breath.
column2: oscillator ຄວາມຖີ່ຕ່ຳ: ຊ້າ ໃຫ້ຕາຕາມທັນ. ໜຶ່ງສ່ວນສີ່ hertz ຄືລົມຫາຍໃຈ ສີ່ວິນາທີ.

column1: Now it MOVES. Okay. Okay. I'm listening.
column2: ດຽວນີ້ ມັນເຄື່ອນໄຫວ. ໂອເຄ. ໂອເຄ. ຂ້ອຍຟັງຢູ່.
ສີຂອງມັນເອງ

column1: Effects that draw a colour, like Edges' line, have a colour chip. It opens the picker: a wheel, typed names, or a colour off the screen.
column2: effect ທີ່ແຕ້ມສີ ເຊັ່ນເສັ້ນຂອງ Edges ມີຊິບສີ. ມັນເປີດຕົວເລືອກ: ວົງລໍ້ ຊື່ທີ່ພິມ ຫຼື ສີຈາກໜ້າຈໍ.

column1: Every colour has a name somewhere. Mine is 'oscilloscope green'. Nobody else uses it.
column2: ທຸກສີ ມີຊື່ຢູ່ບ່ອນໃດບ່ອນໜຶ່ງ. ຂອງຂ້ອຍແມ່ນ 'ຂຽວ oscilloscope'. ບໍ່ມີໃຜໃຊ້.

column1: That colour is doing something. I don't know what. I love it.
column2: ສີນັ້ນ ກຳລັງເຮັດຫຍັງບາງຢ່າງ. ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ຮູ້ວ່າແມ່ນຫຍັງ. ຂ້ອຍມັກມັນ.
ຄຳຕັດສິນ

column1: An effect, a ~ and a colour. The critic is crying, skapi. Good crying, I think.
column2: effect ໜຶ່ງ, ~ ໜຶ່ງ ແລະ ສີໜຶ່ງ. ນັກວິຈານຮ້ອງໄຫ້ skapi. ຮ້ອງແບບດີ ຂ້ອຍຄິດວ່າ.

column1: Stack a few. Each has its own ~ on every knob. That is how a look becomes a performance.
column2: ຊ້ອນຫຼາຍໆອັນ. ແຕ່ລະອັນມີ ~ ຂອງຕົນ ເທິງທຸກປຸ່ມ. ໂຊເບິ່ງເປັນໂຊ ກໍຍ້ອນນີ້.

column1: It's still a square. But it's YOUR square. Post it.
column2: ຍັງເປັນສີ່ຫຼ່ຽມ. ແຕ່ເປັນສີ່ຫຼ່ຽມ ຂອງເຈົ້າ. ສົ່ງອອກໄປ.
ຫ້ອງ TELESTRATOR

column1: Coach Marv explains sport by drawing circles on it. Once he circled the sun. Ten minutes, skapi.
column2: Coach Marv ອະທິບາຍກິລາ ໂດຍແຕ້ມວົງມົນເທິງມັນ. ເທື່ອໜຶ່ງ ລາວແຕ້ມວົງອ້ອມຕາເວັນ. ສິບນາທີ skapi.

column1: Tonight: test patterns, the video synth, and drawing on the picture. Press START.
column2: ຄືນນີ້: ຮູບທົດສອບ synth ວິດີໂອ ແລະ ແຕ້ມເທິງຮູບ. ກົດ START.

column1: Get me a picture and a pen. BOOM.
column2: ເອົາຮູບ ກັບປາກກາມາ. ບູມ.
ຮູບທົດສອບ

column1: Line up the screens BEFORE the show. Not during. I learned this in Plovdiv.
column2: ແກ້ໜ້າຈໍ ກ່ອນ ໂຊ. ບໍ່ແມ່ນລະຫວ່າງ. ຂ້ອຍຮຽນຮູ້ອັນນີ້ ທີ່ Plovdiv.

column1: Every desk needs a test pattern. PATTERN adds Pocket Test: checked against real meters.
column2: ທຸກໂຕະ ຕ້ອງມີຮູບທົດສອບ. PATTERN ເພີ່ມ Pocket Test: ກວດດ້ວຍການວັດແທ້.
SYNTH ວິດີໂອ

column1: He says 'no camera needed' like it is a feature. It is a feature.
column2: ລາວເວົ້າວ່າ 'ບໍ່ຕ້ອງໃຊ້ກ້ອງ' ຄືກັບເປັນຄຸນສົມບັດ. ມັນແມ່ນຄຸນສົມບັດແທ້.

column1: My favourite. SOURCE, then Video Synth: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. No camera needed.
column2: ອັນທີ່ຂ້ອຍມັກທີ່ສຸດ. ແຫຼ່ງ ແລ້ວ Video Synth: oscillator, ກະຈົກ ແລະ feedback. ບໍ່ຕ້ອງໃຊ້ກ້ອງ.
TAKE SYNTH

column1: Select it, then TAKE. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: ເລືອກມັນ ແລ້ວ TAKE. ຜູ້ຄວບຄຸມທີ່ໝັ້ນໃຈ ກົດ Enter.

column1: That's our replay. Every replay needs a pundit.
column2: ນີ້ຄືພາບຊ້ຳຂອງພວກເຮົາ. ທຸກພາບຊ້ຳ ຕ້ອງມີຜູ້ບັນຍາຍ.

column1: Now here's a replay. And here's a guy. And BOOM, he's in it.
column2: ນີ້ພາບຊ້ຳ. ນີ້ນັກກິລາ. ແລະ ບູມ ເຂົ້າແລ້ວ.
PLAYLIST ທີສອງ

column1: Ink goes on top, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: ໝຶກຢູ່ເທິງສຸດ ເທິງ layer ຂອງມັນ. ຄລິກ + ທ້າຍແຖບ playlist.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first. Like a second oscillator, mixed on top.
column2: playlist ທີສອງ ຄື layer ເທິງອັນທຳອິດ. ຄື oscillator ທີສອງ ປະສົມຢູ່ເທິງ.
DRAW CUE

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Draw. Clear everywhere you have not drawn.
column2: ໃນ playlist ໃໝ່: ແຫຼ່ງ ແລ້ວ Draw. ບ່ອນທີ່ເຈົ້າບໍ່ໄດ້ແຕ້ມ ແມ່ນໃສ.

column1: A Draw cue is transparent outside the ink, so the synth shows through.
column2: draw cue ໃສ ນອກໝຶກ ສະນັ້ນ synth ຈຶ່ງເຫັນ.
TAKE ໝຶກ

column1: Select the Draw cue and TAKE it. Two playlists, two layers, one picture.
column2: ເລືອກ draw cue ແລ້ວ TAKE. ສອງ playlist ສອງ layer ໜຶ່ງຮູບ.

column1: Now both are live: the synth underneath, the ink on top.
column2: ດຽວນີ້ ທັງສອງສົດ: synth ຢູ່ລຸ່ມ ໝຶກຢູ່ເທິງ.
ແຕ້ມວົງອ້ອມບາງຢ່າງ

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then draw on the programme monitor. Mouse, or a pen if you have one.
column2: ໃນ inspector ຄລິກ DRAW ແລ້ວແຕ້ມ ເທິງຈໍ program. ດ້ວຍເມົ້າ ຫຼື ປາກກາ ຖ້າມີ.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength. Like me.
column2: ແຮງກົດປາກກາ ເຮັດເສັ້ນໜາ. ເມົ້າກົດແຮງເທົ່າເດີມສະເໝີ. ຄືຂ້ອຍ.

column1: Circle him! No, bigger. BOOM. That's a cloud. Fine. Circle the cloud.
column2: ແຕ້ມວົງອ້ອມລາວ! ບໍ່ ໃຫຍ່ກວ່ານັ້ນ. ບູມ. ນັ້ນແມ່ນເມກ. ບໍ່ເປັນຫຍັງ. ແຕ້ມວົງອ້ອມເມກ.
ບັນທຶກຮູບນິ່ງ

column1: SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, and adds it to the playlist.
column2: SAVE STILL ເກັບການແຕ້ມ ເປັນຮູບພື້ນໃສ ແລະ ເພີ່ມໃສ່ playlist.

column1: For next week's show. Coach Marv will want the cloud again.
column2: ສຳລັບລາຍການອາທິດໜ້າ. Coach Marv ຈະຢາກໄດ້ເມກອີກ.
ນັ້ນແມ່ນຫ້ອງ

column1: Patterns, the synth, a layer, ink, a still. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: ຮູບທົດສອບ synth layer ໝຶກ ຮູບນິ່ງ. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: Try Replay in the Draw section: it draws your lines back the way you drew them.
column2: ລອງ Replay ໃນສ່ວນ Draw: ມັນແຕ້ມເສັ້ນຂອງເຈົ້າຄືນ ຄືກັບຕອນແຕ້ມ.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen. And a turducken.
column2: ອາທິດໜ້າ ເວລາເກົ່າ. ເອົາປາກກາໃຫຍ່ກວ່າມາ. ແລະ ເຂົ້າໜຽວກັບລາບ ໜຶ່ງກະຕິບ.
ຮູບຈານບິນ (ລັບ)
ແຟ້ມສັນຍານ

column1: The Bureau of Unexplained Signals. Two agents, one photo, and it must not air. Press START.
column2: ສຳນັກງານສັນຍານທີ່ອະທິບາຍບໍ່ໄດ້. ສອງເຈົ້າໜ້າທີ່ ໜຶ່ງຮູບ ແລະ ມັນຂຶ້ນອາກາດບໍ່ໄດ້. ກົດ START.

column1: Masks cut a picture into shapes. Tonight we cut evidence.
column2: Mask ຕັດຮູບເປັນຮູບຮ່າງ. ຄືນນີ້ ພວກເຮົາຕັດຫຼັກຖານ.

column1: That's a craft, Brandt. Look at the lights. I want to believe.
column2: ມັນແມ່ນຍານ Brandt. ເບິ່ງແສງນັ້ນ. ຂ້ອຍຢາກເຊື່ອ.
MASK ຈາກຫ້ອງສະໝຸດ

column1: In the inspector's MASK section: mask, then 'new heart'. Any shape will do. The heart is funnier.
column2: ໃນສ່ວນ MASK ຂອງ inspector: mask ແລ້ວ 'new heart'. ຮູບຮ່າງໃດກໍໄດ້. ຫົວໃຈມ່ວນກວ່າ.

column1: The library has circles, stars, hearts. Each one is points you can move.
column2: ຫ້ອງສະໝຸດມີ ວົງມົນ ດາວ ຫົວໃຈ. ແຕ່ລະອັນ ເປັນຈຸດທີ່ເຈົ້າຍ້າຍໄດ້.

column1: A heart, Hollis? The Bureau redacts with black bars.
column2: ຫົວໃຈບໍ Hollis? ສຳນັກງານເຊື່ອງ ດ້ວຍແຖບດຳ.
ປາກກາ

column1: Set the tool to pen, then click round the saucer on the monitor. Click the first point to close it.
column2: ປ່ຽນເຄື່ອງມືເປັນປາກກາ ແລ້ວຄລິກອ້ອມຈານ ເທິງຈໍ. ຄລິກຈຸດທຳອິດ ເພື່ອປິດ.

column1: Click for corners, drag for curves. The way the Bezier brothers intended.
column2: ຄລິກເພື່ອເຮັດມຸມ ລາກເພື່ອເສັ້ນໂຄ້ງ. ຄືທີ່ອ້າຍນ້ອງ Bézier ຕ້ອງການ.

column1: Draw round it carefully. It might be watching.
column2: ແຕ້ມອ້ອມມັນ ຢ່າງລະວັງ. ມັນອາດກຳລັງເບິ່ງ.
ກັບດ້ານ

column1: Invert keeps the outside and cuts the inside. The saucer goes. The sky stays.
column2: ກັບດ້ານ ເກັບຂ້າງນອກ ຕັດຂ້າງໃນ. ຈານຫາຍໄປ. ທ້ອງຟ້າຍັງຢູ່.

column1: The same shape, the other way round. Very useful. Slightly spooky.
column2: ຮູບຮ່າງດຽວກັນ ກັບດ້ານ. ມີປະໂຫຍດຫຼາຍ. ໜ້າຢ້ານໜ້ອຍໜຶ່ງ.

column1: Hollis, there's a heart-shaped hole in the sky.
column2: Hollis ມີຮູຮູບຫົວໃຈ ຢູ່ໃນທ້ອງຟ້າ.
ເຮັດໃຫ້ອ່ອນ

column1: Feather softens the edge, so nobody sees the cut. Press + on feather.
column2: ເຮັດໃຫ້ອ່ອນ ເຮັດຂອບນຸ້ມ ບໍ່ໃຫ້ໃຜເຫັນຮອຍຕັດ. ກົດ + ທີ່ feather.

column1: A hard edge says 'someone was here'. A soft one says nothing at all.
column2: ຂອບແຂງບອກວ່າ 'ມີຄົນຢູ່ນີ້'. ຂອບອ່ອນ ບໍ່ບອກຫຍັງ.
ເຂົາຈະບໍ່ມີວັນຮູ້.
ປິດແຟ້ມ

column1: A library shape, the pen, invert and feather. The Bureau thanks you. The Bureau was never here.
column2: ຮູບຮ່າງຈາກຫ້ອງສະໝຸດ ປາກກາ ກັບດ້ານ ແລະ ອ່ອນ. ສຳນັກງານຂອບໃຈ. ສຳນັກງານບໍ່ເຄີຍຢູ່ນີ້.

column1: Masks also go on a layer, an output, or its matte: MASK ON chooses. And every control takes a ~.
column2: Mask ໃສ່ layer, output ຫຼື matte ຂອງມັນກໍໄດ້: MASK ON ເລືອກ. ແລະ ທຸກການຄວບຄຸມ ຮັບ ~ ໄດ້.

column1: The truth is in the waveform, Hollis. Next time, the scopes.
column2: ຄວາມຈິງ ຢູ່ໃນ waveform Hollis. ເທື່ອໜ້າ ໃຊ້ scope.
ຜີ
ຫໍໄຟມີຜີ

column1: A lighthouse, a ghost, and a keeper who has been alone with the lamp far too long. Press START.
column2: ຫໍໄຟໜຶ່ງ ຜີໜຶ່ງ ແລະ ຄົນເຝົ້າ ທີ່ຢູ່ຄົນດຽວກັບໂຄມໄຟ ດົນເກີນໄປ. ກົດ START.

column1: Projection mapping: bending the picture to fit the building. Warp, blend, slices.
column2: Projection mapping: ດັດຮູບ ໃຫ້ເຂົ້າກັບອາຄານ. Warp, blend, slice.

column1: Ye'll be wanting the ghost on the windows. Mind the lamp. The lamp is MINE.
column2: ພວກເຈົ້າຢາກໄດ້ຜີ ເທິງປ່ອງຢ້ຽມ ແມ່ນບໍ? ລະວັງໂຄມໄຟ. ໂຄມໄຟ ເປັນຂອງຂ້ອຍ.
ເລຂາຄະນິດ OUTPUT

column1: MENU, then Video Outputs, then Geometry. Where an output's shape lives.
column2: ເມນູ ແລ້ວ Video Outputs ແລ້ວ Geometry. ຮູບຮ່າງຂອງ output ຢູ່ນັ້ນ.

column1: Geometry: the projector-menu word for 'what shape is the picture'.
column2: Geometry: ຄຳໃນເມນູເຄື່ອງສາຍ ໝາຍເຖິງ 'ຮູບເປັນຮູບຮ່າງໃດ'.
ປັກມຸມ

column1: Press warp edit, then drag a corner on the programme monitor. The window is not square. Neither is the keeper.
column2: ຄລິກ warp edit ແລ້ວລາກມຸມ ເທິງຈໍ program. ປ່ອງຢ້ຽມ ບໍ່ສີ່ຫຼ່ຽມ. ຄົນເຝົ້າກໍບໍ່.

column1: A corner pin moves the four corners. Perspective keeps the lines straight, like a real window.
column2: Corner pin ຍ້າຍສີ່ມຸມ. ທັດສະນະ ຮັກສາເສັ້ນໃຫ້ຊື່ ຄືປ່ອງຢ້ຽມແທ້.

column1: LEFT! Ye call that a corner? I've seen straighter gulls.
column2: ຊ້າຍ! ເຈົ້າເອີ້ນນັ້ນວ່າມຸມບໍ? ຂ້ອຍເຫັນນົກນາງນວນ ຊື່ກວ່ານີ້.
ສອງຂອບອ່ອນ

column1: Back in Geometry: edge blend, + on the left and + on the right.
column2: ກັບໄປ Geometry: edge blend, + ທາງຊ້າຍ ແລະ + ທາງຂວາ.

column1: Two projectors overlap; each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright.
column2: ສອງເຄື່ອງສາຍ ທັບກັນ; ແຕ່ລະເຄື່ອງ ຈາງຂອບຂອງຕົນ ໃຫ້ບ່ອນທັບ ບໍ່ແຈ້ງສອງເທົ່າ.
ໜ້າຕ່າງ SCREENS

column1: Geometry, SLICES, open. The Screens window is where slices are cut and placed.
column2: Geometry, SLICES, ເປີດ. ໜ້າຕ່າງ Screens ເປັນບ່ອນຕັດ ແລະ ວາງ slice.

column1: A slice is a piece of the picture, put anywhere on the output.
column2: slice ຄືຕ່ອນໜຶ່ງຂອງຮູບ ວາງບ່ອນໃດກໍໄດ້ ໃນ output.
ສາມ SLICE

column1: In the Screens window, + SLICE three times, and drag each crop to a third of the picture.
column2: ໃນໜ້າຕ່າງ Screens, + SLICE ສາມເທື່ອ ແລ້ວລາກແຕ່ລະຮອຍຕັດ ໄປໜຶ່ງສ່ວນສາມຂອງຮູບ.

column1: Three windows, three slices: left, middle and right of one picture.
column2: ສາມປ່ອງຢ້ຽມ ສາມ slice: ຊ້າຍ ກາງ ແລະ ຂວາ ຂອງຮູບດຽວ.

column1: Three windows. The lamp gets the middle one. The lamp ALWAYS gets the middle one.
column2: ສາມປ່ອງຢ້ຽມ. ອັນກາງ ເປັນຂອງໂຄມໄຟ. ອັນກາງ ເປັນຂອງໂຄມໄຟສະເໝີ.
ຜີພໍໃຈ

column1: Warp, blend, slices. The keeper will finally sleep. The gulls will not.
column2: Warp, blend, slice. ຄົນເຝົ້າຈະໄດ້ນອນ ໃນທີ່ສຸດ. ນົກນາງນວນບໍ່.

column1: Slices have their own warp and mesh in the Screens window. And a ~ on the place and the turn.
column2: Slice ມີ warp ແລະ mesh ຂອງມັນ ໃນໜ້າຕ່າງ Screens. ແລະ ~ ເທິງບ່ອນ ແລະ ການໝຸນ.

column1: Ye did alright, lad. Now get away from the lamp.
column2: ເຮັດໄດ້ດີ ນ້ອງ. ດຽວນີ້ ອອກໄປໃຫ້ໄກໂຄມໄຟ.
ເກມໂຊ

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and cues that fire from anywhere. Press START.
column2: ເກມໂຊໂທລະທັດ skapi. ສາມຜູ້ແຂ່ງ ກະດິ່ງໜຶ່ງ ແລະ cue ທີ່ຍິງມາຈາກທຸກທາງ. ກົດ START.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines. Like a sequencer you can play from any key.
column2: ເລກ cue ປຸ່ມລັດ ແລະ GO ຈາກເຄື່ອງອື່ນ. ຄື sequencer ທີ່ເຈົ້າຕີດ້ວຍປຸ່ມໃດກໍໄດ້.

column1: Welcome to the show! Let's spin that wheel!
column2: ຍິນດີຕ້ອນຮັບສູ່ລາຍການ! ໝຸນວົງລໍ້ກັນ!
ເລກ CUE

column1: Contestant 3 is selected. In the inspector's metadata, give it a cue number: 3.
column2: ຜູ້ແຂ່ງເລກ 3 ຖືກເລືອກ. ໃນ metadata ຂອງ inspector ໃຫ້ເລກ cue: 3.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: ໂຊ ໃສ່ເລກ cue ຂອງຕົນ. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy ອ່ານໄດ້ໝົດ.

column1: I'd like to buy a number, please.
column2: ຂ້ອຍຂໍຊື້ຕົວເລກໜຶ່ງ ແດ່.
ໄປຫາມັນ

column1: Ctrl+G, type the number, Enter. It goes live wherever the list happens to be standing.
column2: Ctrl+G ພິມເລກ Enter. ມັນຂຶ້ນສົດ ລາຍການຢູ່ໃສກໍຕາມ.

column1: GOTO. The fastest way across a long list. Faster than scrolling. Much faster than me.
column2: GOTO. ທາງໄວທີ່ສຸດ ໃນລາຍການຍາວ. ໄວກວ່າເລື່ອນ. ໄວກວ່າຂ້ອຍຫຼາຍ.
ແລະ ເລກແມ່ນ... ສາມ!
ກະດິ່ງ

column1: Contestant 1 is selected. In TRIGGERS, press key, then F5. That key now fires this cue.
column2: ຜູ້ແຂ່ງເລກ 1 ຖືກເລືອກ. ໃນ TRIGGERS ຄລິກ key ແລ້ວ F5. ປຸ່ມນັ້ນ ດຽວນີ້ຍິງ cue ນີ້.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one, a buzzer.
column2: F1 ຫາ F10, F12 ຫຼື ແປ້ນເລກ. ແຕ່ລະອັນ ເປັນກະດິ່ງ.
ຜູ້ແຂ່ງແຕ່ລະຄົນ ໄດ້ກະດິ່ງ.
ກົດກະດິ່ງ!

column1: Press the key. The cue fires, wherever the list is standing.
column2: ກົດປຸ່ມ. cue ຍິງ ລາຍການຢູ່ໃສກໍຕາມ.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Just the key.
column2: ບໍ່ມີເມົ້າ ບໍ່ມີລາຍການ ບໍ່ຕ້ອງເບິ່ງ. ພຽງແຕ່ປຸ່ມ.
ຕິ໊ດ! ພວກເຮົາມີຜູ້ຊະນະ!
ຈາກທຸກບ່ອນ

column1: Companion, a MIDI note, an OSC message: MENU, then Network, says where each one connects.
column2: Companion, ໂນດ MIDI, ຂໍ້ຄວາມ OSC: ເມນູ ແລ້ວ ເຄືອຂ່າຍ ບອກວ່າແຕ່ລະອັນຕໍ່ໃສ.

column1: A Stream Deck in the next room can press GO. So can a keyboard synth. I prefer the synth.
column2: Stream Deck ໃນຫ້ອງຂ້າງ ກົດ GO ໄດ້. synth ຄີບອດ ກໍໄດ້. ຂ້ອຍມັກ synth ກວ່າ.

column1: And for our viewers at home: you can play along too.
column2: ແລະ ສຳລັບຜູ້ຊົມທີ່ບ້ານ: ພວກເຈົ້າກໍຫຼິ້ນໄດ້.
ນັ້ນແມ່ນລາຍການຂອງພວກເຮົາ

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You are a game show now, skapi.
column2: ເລກ GOTO ກະດິ່ງ ແລະ GO ຈາກທຸກບ່ອນ. ດຽວນີ້ ເຈົ້າເປັນເກມໂຊ skapi.

column1: A cue can have a key, a MIDI note and an OSC address at once. Belt, braces and a second belt.
column2: cue ໜຶ່ງ ມີປຸ່ມ ໂນດ MIDI ແລະ ທີ່ຢູ່ OSC ພ້ອມກັນໄດ້. ສາຍແອວ ສາຍຮັດ ແລະ ສາຍແອວອີກເສັ້ນ.
ຝັນດີ ທຸກຄົນ! ໝຸນຕໍ່ໄປ!
ແຜນທີ່ອາກາດ
ອາກາດ KAIJU

column1: Channel 6 weather, skapi. A map, a presenter, and a very large lizard. Press START.
column2: ອາກາດຊ່ອງ 6 skapi. ແຜນທີ່ໜຶ່ງ ຜູ້ນຳສະເໜີ ແລະ ແລນໂຕໃຫຍ່ຫຼາຍ. ກົດ START.

column1: Words on screen: Lower Thirds, text, and backdrops.
column2: ຄຳເທິງໜ້າຈໍ: Lower Third ຂໍ້ຄວາມ ແລະ ພື້ນ.

column1: I'm June O'Neil, and nothing about this forecast is normal.
column2: ຂ້ອຍຊື່ June O'Neil ແລະ ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງປົກກະຕິ ໃນການພະຍາກອນນີ້.
LAYER ສຳລັບຄຳ

column1: Words go on their own layer: press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: ຄຳຢູ່ເທິງ layer ຂອງຕົນ: ຄລິກ + ທ້າຍແຖບ playlist.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. Mostly.
column2: playlist ທີສອງ ຄື layer ເທິງແຜນທີ່. ແລນຢູ່ລຸ່ມ. ສ່ວນຫຼາຍ.

column1: Words on top. Always on top.
column2: ຄຳຢູ່ເທິງ. ຢູ່ເທິງສະເໝີ.
LOWER THIRD

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Lower Third.
column2: ໃນ playlist ໃໝ່: ແຫຼ່ງ ແລ້ວ Lower Third.

column1: A name and a title, low on the screen, out of the lizard's way.
column2: ຊື່ ແລະ ຕຳແໜ່ງ ຢູ່ລຸ່ມຈໍ ພົ້ນທາງແລນ.
ຊື່ຂອງລາວ

column1: In the inspector, title: type the presenter's name. The second line is her job.
column2: ໃນ inspector, title: ພິມຊື່ຜູ້ນຳສະເໜີ. ແຖວທີສອງ ແມ່ນວຽກຂອງລາວ.

column1: Spelling counts. The audience reads it at the speed of light.
column2: ການສະກົດ ສຳຄັນ. ຜູ້ຊົມອ່ານ ໄວເທົ່າແສງ.

column1: Spell it right. Last week it said 'Jane O'Meal'.
column2: ຂຽນໃຫ້ຖືກ. ອາທິດແລ້ວ ມັນຂຽນວ່າ 'Jane O'Meal'.
ສົດ

column1: TAKE the Lower Third. Her name slides in over the map.
column2: TAKE Lower Third. ຊື່ລາວເລື່ອນເຂົ້າເທິງແຜນທີ່.

column1: Two layers live: the weather, and the words on top of it.
column2: ສອງ layer ສົດ: ອາກາດ ແລະ ຄຳເທິງມັນ.

column1: Thank you. Now, about that lizard...
column2: ຂອບໃຈ. ດຽວນີ້ ເລື່ອງແລນໂຕນັ້ນ...
ຂ່າວດ່ວນ

column1: SOURCE, then Text: a title card. Then its backdrop chip: key green, for the vision mixer to key out.
column2: ແຫຼ່ງ ແລ້ວ Text: ບັດຫົວຂໍ້. ແລ້ວຊິບພື້ນ: ຂຽວ key ໃຫ້ mixer ເອົາອອກ.

column1: A backdrop fills behind the words. Key green or key blue, and the mixer does the rest.
column2: ພື້ນ ເຕີມທາງຫຼັງຄຳ. ຂຽວ ຫຼື ຟ້າ key ສ່ວນທີ່ເຫຼືອ mixer ເຮັດ.

column1: Breaking news: it's standing on the five-day forecast.
column2: ດ່ວນ: ມັນຢຽບການພະຍາກອນ ຫ້າວັນແລ້ວ.
ດ່ວນ: KAIJU
ກັບຄືນສະຕູດິໂອ

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio, skapi.
column2: Lower Third ຊື່ ບັດຫົວຂໍ້ ພື້ນ. ແລນອອກຈາກສະຕູດິໂອແລ້ວ skapi.

column1: Lower Thirds can wait, slide and leave on their own. Their section has every setting.
column2: Lower Third ລໍຖ້າເອງ ເລື່ອນເຂົ້າ ເລື່ອນອອກໄດ້. ສ່ວນຂອງມັນ ມີທຸກການຕັ້ງຄ່າ.

column1: That's the weather. Back to you, guys. Run.
column2: ອາກາດມີເທົ່ານີ້. ກັບຄືນສະຕູດິໂອ. ແລ່ນເລີຍ.
ມື້ຍິ່ງໃຫຍ່

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, and an inventor who wants cheese. Press START.
column2: ບັ້ງໄຟ ທີ່ສ້າງໃນຫ້ອງໃຕ້ດິນ skapi ແລະ ນັກປະດິດ ທີ່ຢາກກິນເນີຍແຂງ. ກົດ START.

column1: Stage timers: countdowns, clocks, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: ໂມງເວທີ: ນັບຖອຍຫຼັງ ໂມງ ແລະ ຈໍຜູ້ນຳສະເໜີ.

column1: Cheese, Grommet! The moon's made of it. We'll need a countdown.
column2: ເນີຍແຂງ Grommet! ດວງເດືອນ ເຮັດດ້ວຍເນີຍແຂງ. ພວກເຮົາຕ້ອງນັບຖອຍຫຼັງ.
ນັບຖອຍຫຼັງ

column1: SOURCE, then Stage Timer. A clock that counts down, in big friendly numbers.
column2: ແຫຼ່ງ ແລ້ວ Stage Timer. ໂມງນັບຖອຍ ເລກໃຫຍ່ ແລະ ເປັນມິດ.

column1: Its colours change as it runs out: white, amber, red. Like a VU meter for time.
column2: ສີປ່ຽນ ເມື່ອເວລາໃກ້ໝົດ: ຂາວ ເຫຼືອງອຳພັນ ແດງ. ຄື VU meter ຂອງເວລາ.
*ຍົກຄິ້ວຂ້າງໜຶ່ງ*
ທະຍານ

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. The countdown starts.
column2: ເລືອກໂມງ ແລ້ວ TAKE. ການນັບເລີ່ມ.

column1: Past zero it keeps going, counting the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: ເລີຍສູນແລ້ວ ມັນຍັງນັບ ເວລາທີ່ເກີນ. ຖືກຕ້ອງຫຼາຍ. ບໍ່ສຸພາບໜ້ອຍໜຶ່ງ.

column1: Ten... nine... ooh, I do love a countdown.
column2: ສິບ... ເກົ້າ... ໂອ້ ຂ້ອຍມັກການນັບຖອຍຫຼັງ.
ຢຸດ!

column1: Something's loose! Space holds the countdown. The clock shows it is held.
column2: ມີຫຍັງຫຼຸດ! Space ພັກການນັບ. ໂມງສະແດງວ່າພັກຢູ່.

column1: A hold is not a stop. Space again, and it carries on from where it was.
column2: ພັກ ບໍ່ແມ່ນ ຈົບ. Space ອີກ ມັນສືບຕໍ່ຈາກບ່ອນເກົ່າ.
*ຍົກກະແຈປາກຕາຍ*
ຈໍຂອງນັກບິນ

column1: MENU, Video Outputs: make an output's type PRESENTER. The person on stage gets the timer, the next cue and their notes.
column2: ເມນູ, Video Outputs: ປ່ຽນປະເພດ output ເປັນ PRESENTER. ຄົນເທິງເວທີ ເຫັນໂມງ cue ຕໍ່ໄປ ແລະ ບັນທຶກ.

column1: A presenter view is an output like any other. Point it at the confidence monitor.
column2: ຈໍຜູ້ນຳສະເໜີ ເປັນ output ຄືອັນອື່ນ. ສົ່ງມັນໄປຈໍເວທີ.

column1: So the pilot can see the time. The pilot is Grommet.
column2: ໃຫ້ນັກບິນເຫັນເວລາ. ນັກບິນແມ່ນ Grommet.
ສູ່ດວງເດືອນ

column1: A countdown, a hold, and a view for the pilot. Nazdrave, skapi. Bring crackers.
column2: ການນັບ ການພັກ ແລະ ຈໍສຳລັບນັກບິນ. Nazdrave, skapi. ເອົາເຂົ້າຈີ່ມາ.

column1: Timers can also count up, or show the time of day. Their section has the lot.
column2: ໂມງ ນັບຂຶ້ນ ຫຼື ສະແດງເວລາ ກໍໄດ້. ສ່ວນຂອງມັນ ມີໝົດ.

column1: A grand day out, Grommet! Pass the crackers.
column2: ມື້ຍິ່ງໃຫຍ່ Grommet! ສົ່ງເຂົ້າຈີ່ມາໃຫ້ແດ່.
ກ່ອງ (ປິດ)
ກ່ອງ (ເປີດ)
ໂຊມາຍາກົນ

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a prop, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: ໂຊມາຍາກົນ skapi. ກ່ອງໜຶ່ງ ອຸປະກອນປະກອບ ແລະ ຈັງຫວະດຽວ ທີ່ປ່ຽນທຸກຢ່າງພ້ອມກັນ. ກົດ START.

column1: Two playlists are two layers. TAKE ALL changes both together.
column2: ສອງ playlist ຄືສອງ layer. TAKE ALL ປ່ຽນທັງສອງ ພ້ອມກັນ.

column1: Every trick needs two things happening at once. And a rubber chicken.
column2: ທຸກກົນ ຕ້ອງມີສອງຢ່າງ ເກີດພ້ອມກັນ. ແລະ ໄກ່ຢາງ.

column1: The prop goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: ອຸປະກອນປະກອບ ຢູ່ເທິງ layer ຂອງມັນ. ຄລິກ + ທ້າຍແຖບ playlist.

column1: Playlist 2 sits on top of playlist 1. Like a transparency on an overhead projector.
column2: Playlist 2 ນັ່ງເທິງ playlist 1. ຄືແຜ່ນໃສ ເທິງເຄື່ອງສາຍ overhead.

column1: Nothing up my sleeve. Everything in my trunk.
column2: ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງໃນແຂນເສື້ອ. ທຸກຢ່າງ ໃນກ່ອງຂອງຂ້ອຍ.
ອຸປະກອນປະກອບ

column1: In the new playlist, add anything: PATTERN will do. That is the prop.
column2: ໃນ playlist ໃໝ່ ເພີ່ມຫຍັງກໍໄດ້: PATTERN ກໍດີ. ນັ້ນແມ່ນອຸປະກອນ.

column1: Whatever it is, it will appear the instant the trunk opens.
column2: ບໍ່ວ່າມັນແມ່ນຫຍັງ ມັນຈະປາກົດ ເມື່ອກ່ອງເປີດ.

column1: Is it a rubber chicken? It's always a rubber chicken.
column2: ໄກ່ຢາງບໍ? ໄກ່ຢາງສະເໝີ.
ອຸປະກອນ (ໄກ່ຢາງ)

column1: Select 'The trunk (open)' in playlist 1 and the prop in playlist 2. Then TAKE ALL: both on one beat.
column2: ເລືອກ 'ກ່ອງ (ເປີດ)' ໃນ playlist 1 ແລະ ອຸປະກອນ ໃນ playlist 2. ແລ້ວ TAKE ALL: ທັງສອງ ໃນຈັງຫວະດຽວ.

column1: One press, every playlist's selected cue. The audience never sees the seam.
column2: ຄລິກດຽວ cue ທີ່ເລືອກຂອງທຸກ playlist. ຜູ້ຊົມບໍ່ເຄີຍເຫັນຮອຍຫຍິບ.
Ta-daaa! ...ລໍຖ້າສຽງຕົບມື. ລໍຖ້າ. ລໍຖ້າ.
ກົນໃຫຍ່

column1: Two layers, one beat. Every playlist has its own opacity and can sit on any output. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: ສອງ layer ໜຶ່ງຈັງຫວະ. ແຕ່ລະ playlist ມີຄວາມໂປ່ງໃສຂອງຕົນ ແລະ ນັ່ງເທິງ output ໃດກໍໄດ້. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A magician never reveals. A playlist never minds being revealed.
column2: ນັກມາຍາກົນ ບໍ່ເຄີຍເປີດເຜີຍ. playlist ບໍ່ຖືສາ ທີ່ຈະເປີດເຜີຍ.

column1: Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: ຂອບໃຈ! ຂ້ອຍຢູ່ນີ້ທັງອາທິດ! ໄກ່ຢູ່ນີ້ຕະຫຼອດໄປ.
ເຮືອນຄົວ (ໄຟໄໝ້)
Soufflé ງາມໆ
ໂຊເຮັດອາຫານ

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. Everything is on fire. Press START.
column2: ໂຊເຮັດອາຫານ skapi. ສົດ. ທຸກຢ່າງໄຟໄໝ້. ກົດ START.

column1: BLACK hides the picture and keeps the show running. PANIC stops everything. Know which you need.
column2: BLACK ເຊື່ອງຮູບ ແລະ ໃຫ້ໂຊແລ່ນຕໍ່. PANIC ຢຸດທຸກຢ່າງ. ຮູ້ວ່າຕ້ອງໃຊ້ອັນໃດ.

column1: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, de kitchen is fire-a-flurdy!
column2: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, ເຮືອນຄົວໄຟໄໝ້-flurdy!

column1: The audience must not see this. Press BLACK, or B.
column2: ຜູ້ຊົມຕ້ອງບໍ່ເຫັນອັນນີ້. ກົດ BLACK ຫຼື B.

column1: The picture goes. The cue keeps playing underneath, ready to come back.
column2: ຮູບຫາຍໄປ. cue ຫຼິ້ນຢູ່ລຸ່ມ ພ້ອມກັບມາ.

column1: Bork? Bork. Oh, de picture is gun.
column2: Bork? Bork. ໂອ້ ຮູບຫາຍໄປແລ້ວ.
ແລະ ກັບ

column1: The fire's out. Press B again: the picture comes back, still running.
column2: ໄຟມອດແລ້ວ. ກົດ B ອີກ: ຮູບກັບມາ ຍັງແລ່ນຢູ່.

column1: Nothing was lost. A mute on a mixer, for pictures.
column2: ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງເສຍ. ປຸ່ມ mute ເທິງ mixer ສຳລັບຮູບ.
Ta-da! ຍັງເຮັດອາຫານຢູ່!

column1: Worse: MENU, System, the SAFETY card: PANIC. Everything stops, the way the panic setting says.
column2: ຮ້າຍກວ່ານັ້ນ: ເມນູ, ລະບົບ, ບັດ SAFETY: PANIC. ທຸກຢ່າງຢຸດ ຕາມທີ່ໂປຣໄຟລ໌ panic ກຳນົດ.

column1: PANIC is the big red button. Use it when BLACK is not enough. Then breathe.
column2: PANIC ຄືປຸ່ມແດງໃຫຍ່. ໃຊ້ເມື່ອ BLACK ບໍ່ພໍ. ແລ້ວຫາຍໃຈ.
ເອົາຄືນ

column1: Close MENU, select the souffle, and TAKE it. The show is back on.
column2: ປິດ ເມນູ ເລືອກ soufflé ແລ້ວ TAKE. ໂຊກັບມາ.

column1: After a panic, the show is still there. Pick up where you meant to be.
column2: ຫຼັງ panic ໂຊຍັງຢູ່. ສືບຕໍ່ຈາກບ່ອນທີ່ເຈົ້າຕ້ອງການ.

column1: Voila! De souffle, he is risen!
column2: Voilà! Soufflé ຟູຂຶ້ນແລ້ວ!
ກິນໃຫ້ແຊບ

column1: BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen, skapi.
column2: BLACK ເພື່ອເຊື່ອງ PANIC ເພື່ອຢຸດ TAKE ເພື່ອກັບຄືນ. ເຈົ້າຈະລອດທຸກເຮືອນຄົວ skapi.

column1: The panic setting chooses what PANIC does: fade out, cut, or just the outputs.
column2: ໂປຣໄຟລ໌ panic ເລືອກວ່າ PANIC ຈະເຮັດຫຍັງ: fade out, ຕັດ ຫຼື ສະເພາະ output.
Bork bork bork! ຝັນດີ!
ພາບທີໜຶ່ງ
ພາບທີສອງ

column1: Presets, skapi. A whole look, remembered, and back with one button. Press START.
column2: Preset skapi. ພາບທັງໝົດ ຈື່ໄວ້ ແລະ ກັບມາດ້ວຍປຸ່ມດຽວ. ກົດ START.

column1: Like the patch memory on a synth: store, then recall.
column2: ຄືໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳ patch ເທິງ synth: ບັນທຶກມັນ ແລ້ວເອີ້ນຄືນ.
DASH

column1: Press DASH: buttons of your own, for anything at all.
column2: ຄລິກ DASH: ປຸ່ມຂອງເຈົ້າເອງ ສຳລັບທຸກຢ່າງ.

column1: Ctrl+D also works. Very fast. Very professional.
column2: Ctrl+D ກໍໄດ້. ໄວຫຼາຍ. ມືອາຊີບຫຼາຍ.
ປຸ່ມ PRESET

column1: Press +, then 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. The button remembers this look.
column2: ຄລິກ + ແລ້ວ 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. ປຸ່ມຈະຈື່ພາບນີ້.

column1: Store. Like saving the patch before the drummer leans on the synth.
column2: ບັນທຶກມັນ. ຄືບັນທຶກ patch ກ່ອນມືກອງ ອີງ synth.
ປ່ຽນທຸກຢ່າງ

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it. A different look.
column2: ປິດ DASH (Esc) ແລ້ວເລືອກ ພາບທີສອງ ແລ້ວ TAKE. ພາບອື່ນ.

column1: Change it all. Don't worry. It remembers.
column2: ປ່ຽນທຸກຢ່າງ. ບໍ່ເປັນຫຍັງ. ມັນຈື່.
ຄລິກດຽວ

column1: Open the DASH and press your preset button. The first look comes back.
column2: ເປີດ DASH ແລ້ວຄລິກປຸ່ມ preset ຂອງເຈົ້າ. ພາບທຳອິດກັບມາ.

column1: Recall. The patch memory, returning. Beautiful.
column2: ເອີ້ນຄືນແລ້ວ. ໜ່ວຍຄວາມຈຳ patch ກັບມາ. ງາມ.

column1: A look, stored and recalled. A preset can keep cues, positions, effects, levels and routing; its button's menu chooses which.
column2: ພາບໜຶ່ງ ເກັບໄວ້ ແລະ ເອີ້ນຄືນ. Preset ເກັບ cue, ຕຳແໜ່ງ, effect, ລະດັບ ແລະ ເສັ້ນທາງໄດ້; ເມນູຂອງປຸ່ມ ເລືອກອັນໃດ.

column1: And a DASH button can run any command at all. Any. Even the exciting ones.
column2: ແລະ ປຸ່ມ DASH ແລ່ນຄຳສັ່ງໃດກໍໄດ້. ທຸກອັນ. ລວມທັງອັນທີ່ຕື່ນເຕັ້ນ.
ຫົວຂໍ້ເປີດ
ດາວເຄາະ
ສົງຄາມ
ຕົວຢ່າງໜັງ

column1: A space-opera trailer, skapi. A narrator with a very deep voice and opinions about transitions. Press START.
column2: ຕົວຢ່າງໜັງອະວະກາດ skapi. ຜູ້ບັນຍາຍ ສຽງທຸ້ມຫຼາຍ ແລະ ມີຄວາມຄິດຫຼາຍ ກ່ຽວກັບ transition. ກົດ START.

column1: A transition is how one cue becomes the next. There are far more than the crossfade.
column2: transition ຄືວິທີທີ່ cue ໜຶ່ງ ກາຍເປັນອີກອັນ. ມີຫຼາຍກວ່າ crossfade ຫຼາຍ.

column1: In a galaxy of content... one operator... must choose a transition.
column2: ໃນກາແລັກຊີ ຂອງເນື້ອຫາ... ຜູ້ຄວບຄຸມ... ຕ້ອງເລືອກ transition.
ແບບໜຶ່ງ

column1: 'The planet' is selected. In the inspector, its transition style: choose iris.
column2: 'ດາວເຄາະ' ຖືກເລືອກ. ໃນ inspector ແບບ transition ຂອງມັນ: ເລືອກ iris.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white. Even a portal. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Push, wipe, iris, dip to white. ແມ່ນແຕ່ປະຕູມິຕິ. ຂ້ອຍຂຽນເຄິ່ງໜຶ່ງ. ວັນອັງຄານ.

column1: The planet deserves... a dramatic entrance.
column2: ດາວເຄາະ ສົມຄວນ... ການປາກົດຕົວອັນຍິ່ງໃຫຍ່.
ເວລາ

column1: Give it a time: + on transition until it says a second or more.
column2: ໃຫ້ເວລາມັນ: + ທີ່ transition ຈົນມັນບອກໜຶ່ງວິນາທີ ຫຼື ຫຼາຍກວ່າ.

column1: No time, no transition. A style needs a duration to do anything at all.
column2: ບໍ່ມີເວລາ ບໍ່ມີ transition. ແບບ ຕ້ອງມີເວລາ ຈຶ່ງເຮັດຫຍັງໄດ້.
ແລ່ນເລີຍ

column1: TAKE the planet. Watch it arrive.
column2: TAKE ດາວເຄາະ. ເບິ່ງມັນມາ.

column1: The transition belongs to the cue arriving. Each cue chooses its own entrance.
column2: transition ເປັນຂອງ cue ທີ່ເຂົ້າມາ. ທຸກ cue ເລືອກທາງເຂົ້າຂອງຕົນ.
Autobot... ແລ່ນ transition.
ສົງຄາມ

column1: Now 'The battle': choose shatter, give it a time, and TAKE it.
column2: ດຽວນີ້ 'ສົງຄາມ': ເລືອກ shatter ໃຫ້ເວລາ ແລ້ວ TAKE.

column1: Shatter drops the old picture like a pane of glass. Please do not do this at a funeral.
column2: Shatter ແຕກຮູບເກົ່າ ຄືແກ້ວ. ກະລຸນາ ຢ່າໃຊ້ໃນງານແຕ່ງ.
ປ່ຽນຮ່າງ... ແລະ ແຕກ!
ກຳລັງສາຍ

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: ແບບໜຶ່ງ ເວລາໜຶ່ງ ແລະ ສອງທາງເຂົ້າ ທີ່ຍິ່ງໃຫຍ່ຫຼາຍ. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A playlist has a default style too, for every cue that does not choose its own.
column2: playlist ກໍມີແບບເລີ່ມຕົ້ນ ສຳລັບ cue ທີ່ບໍ່ເລືອກເອງ.

column1: Coming soon... to a desk near you.
column2: ໄວໆນີ້... ເທິງໂຕະ ໃກ້ເຈົ້າ.
ຈັງຫວະ
DJ ຫຸ່ນຍົນ

column1: Two robot DJs, skapi. They do not talk. Their helmets do. Press START.
column2: ສອງ DJ ຫຸ່ນຍົນ skapi. ພວກເຂົາບໍ່ເວົ້າ. ໝວກກັນກະທົບເວົ້າແທນ. ກົດ START.

column1: Every cue has its own chain of audio effects, and some of them break the sound on purpose.
column2: ທຸກ cue ມີສາຍ effect ສຽງ ຂອງຕົນ ແລະ ບາງອັນ ຕັ້ງໃຈທຳລາຍສຽງ.

column1: > HELLO. WE ARE HERE TO FIX YOUR MIX.
column2: > ສະບາຍດີ. ພວກເຮົາມາແກ້ MIX ຂອງເຈົ້າ.

column1: The beat is selected. In its AUDIO EFFECTS section, + adds one. Try the delay.
column2: ຈັງຫວະ ຖືກເລືອກ. ໃນສ່ວນ AUDIO EFFECTS, + ເພີ່ມອັນໜຶ່ງ. ລອງ Delay.

column1: Delay, reverb, filters, a compressor. Amount always means 'less of this'.
column2: Delay, reverb, filter, compressor. Amount ໝາຍເຖິງ 'ໜ້ອຍລົງ' ສະເໝີ.

column1: > ONE MORE TIME. WITH ECHO. ECHO. ECHO.
column2: > ອີກເທື່ອ. ມີສຽງກ້ອງ. ກ້ອງ. ກ້ອງ.
BEND ໜຶ່ງ

column1: Add a second: a bend, like crush. It damages the sound the way a broken file would.
column2: ເພີ່ມອັນທີສອງ: bend ເຊັ່ນ crush. ມັນທຳລາຍສຽງ ຄືໄຟລ໌ເສຍ.

column1: The bends are my favourite. Like a tape left in the sun. On purpose.
column2: bend ຄືອັນທີ່ຂ້ອຍມັກທີ່ສຸດ. ຄືກະແຊັດ ທີ່ລືມໄວ້ກາງແດດ. ຕັ້ງໃຈ.
> ແຮງຂຶ້ນ. ດີຂຶ້ນ. ກອບຂຶ້ນ. ດັງຂຶ້ນ.
PATCH

column1: MENU, then Audio: where each playlist's sound goes, and the patch for named outputs.
column2: ເມນູ ແລ້ວ ສຽງ: ສຽງຂອງແຕ່ລະ playlist ໄປໃສ ແລະ patch ສຳລັບ output ທີ່ມີຊື່.

column1: Speakers, monitors, an in-ear for the drummer. The patch sends each its own.
column2: ລຳໂພງ ຈໍຟັງ in-ear ສຳລັບມືກອງ. Patch ສົ່ງໃຫ້ແຕ່ລະຄົນ ສ່ວນຂອງຕົນ.

column1: > AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX.
column2: > ອ້ອມ MIX. ອ້ອມ MIX. ອ້ອມ MIX.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, skapi. I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: effect bend ແລະ patch. ຫຸ່ນຍົນເຫັນດີ skapi. ຂ້ອຍຄິດວ່າ. ໜ້າພວກເຂົາ ແມ່ນໝວກ.

column1: Every audio effect can follow a ~ too, even Motion. Wave at the delay. It's wonderful.
column2: ທຸກ effect ສຽງ ຕາມ ~ ໄດ້ ລວມທັງ Motion. ໂບກມືໃສ່ delay. ມະຫັດສະຈັນ.

column1: > THANK YOU. GOOD NIGHT. WE ARE ROBOTS.
column2: > ຂອບໃຈ. ຝັນດີ. ພວກເຮົາແມ່ນຫຸ່ນຍົນ.
ແສງເທິງຂອບຟ້າ (ຫຼັກຖານ #2)
ຫຼັກຖານ #2

column1: The Bureau again, skapi. A glow on the horizon, and two agents who disagree about it. Press START.
column2: ສຳນັກງານອີກແລ້ວ skapi. ແສງເທິງຂອບຟ້າ ແລະ ສອງເຈົ້າໜ້າທີ່ ທີ່ເຫັນບໍ່ກົງກັນ. ກົດ START.

column1: The scopes measure a picture: brightness, colour, levels. Numbers, not opinions.
column2: Scope ວັດຮູບ: ຄວາມແຈ້ງ ສີ ລະດັບ. ຕົວເລກ ບໍ່ແມ່ນຄວາມເຫັນ.

column1: It's them, Brandt. It's a craft. Look how it glows.
column2: ແມ່ນພວກເຂົາ Brandt. ແມ່ນຍານ. ເບິ່ງມັນເຫຼື້ອມ.
ສັນຍານແທ້

column1: The scopes read only what really goes out, never a preview. Turn the output on: MENU, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.
column2: Scope ອ່ານສະເພາະສິ່ງທີ່ອອກແທ້ ບໍ່ເຄີຍອ່ານຕົວຢ່າງ. ເປີດ output: ເມນູ, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.

column1: Measuring a scaled-down preview would be measuring a photocopy. We measure the original.
column2: ວັດຕົວຢ່າງທີ່ຍໍ່ ຄືວັດສຳເນົາ. ພວກເຮົາວັດຕົ້ນສະບັບ.

column1: Chain of evidence, Hollis. The real signal or nothing.
column2: ລະບົບຫຼັກຖານ Hollis. ສັນຍານແທ້ ຫຼື ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງເລີຍ.
SCOPE

column1: Close MENU. Above the monitor, the PROGRAM button: press it until it says SCOPES or BOTH.
column2: ປິດ ເມນູ. ເທິງຈໍ ປຸ່ມ PROGRAM: ຄລິກຈົນມັນບອກ SCOPES ຫຼື BOTH.

column1: Both shows the picture and its scopes side by side. Very civilised.
column2: BOTH ສະແດງຮູບ ແລະ scope ຂອງມັນ ຄຽງກັນ. ມີອາລະຍະທຳຫຼາຍ.
ໃຫ້ scope ຕັດສິນ Hollis.
WAVEFORM

column1: Click the waveform to make it big. Bright things sit high, dark things low, left to right as in the picture.
column2: ຄລິກ waveform ເພື່ອຂະຫຍາຍ. ສິ່ງແຈ້ງຢູ່ເທິງ ມືດຢູ່ລຸ່ມ ຊ້າຍຫາຂວາ ຄືໃນຮູບ.

column1: The glow is that spike near the top. Very bright. Bright is not the same as alien.
column2: ແສງ ຄືຍອດໃກ້ເທິງສຸດ. ແຈ້ງຫຼາຍ. ແຈ້ງ ບໍ່ແມ່ນມະນຸດຕ່າງດາວ.

column1: Look at the peak. Nothing a streetlight couldn't do.
column2: ເບິ່ງຍອດນັ້ນ. ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງ ທີ່ໄຟທາງເຮັດບໍ່ໄດ້.
VECTORSCOPE

column1: Click it again to go back, then click the vectorscope: colour round a circle. Saturated runs to the edge.
column2: ຄລິກອີກ ເພື່ອກັບ ແລ້ວຄລິກ vectorscope: ສີອ້ອມວົງ. ຄວາມອີ່ມ ແລ່ນໄປຂອບ.

column1: Magenta, far out by the rim. A strong colour. Strong is not illegal. Yet.
column2: ສີບົວແດງ ໄປເຖິງຂອບ. ສີແຮງ. ແຮງ ບໍ່ຜິດກົດໝາຍ. ຍັງ.

column1: It's off the chart, Brandt! Literally off the chart!
column2: ມັນອອກນອກແຜນວາດ Brandt! ແທ້ໆ!
ສີປອມ

column1: And false colour: red is clipped, yellow nearly. Is the glow red?
column2: ແລະ ສີປອມ: ແດງ ຖືກຕັດ ເຫຼືອງ ເກືອບ. ແສງເປັນສີແດງບໍ?

column1: Clipped means the brightest the signal can carry, and then some lost. Detail gone.
column2: ຖືກຕັດ ໝາຍເຖິງແຈ້ງທີ່ສຸດ ທີ່ສັນຍານຖືໄດ້ ແລະ ບາງສ່ວນເກີນນັ້ນເສຍໄປ. ລາຍລະອຽດຫາຍ.

column1: Red. Clipped. Not alien, Hollis. Just too bright. Case closed.
column2: ແດງ. ຖືກຕັດ. ບໍ່ແມ່ນມະນຸດຕ່າງດາວ Hollis. ພຽງແຈ້ງເກີນ. ປິດແຟ້ມ.
ຄວາມຈິງ

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it, skapi. The agents did not.
column2: Waveform, vectorscope, ສີປອມ. Scope ຕັດສິນແລ້ວ skapi. ບໍ່ແມ່ນເຈົ້າໜ້າທີ່.

column1: SCOPES SOURCE reads any output, and the matrix can be 709 or 2020. For the curious.
column2: SCOPES SOURCE ອ່ານ output ໃດກໍໄດ້ ແລະ ມາຕຣິກເປັນ 709 ຫຼື 2020 ໄດ້. ສຳລັບຄົນຢາກຮູ້.

column1: Too bright for a streetlight, Brandt. Too bright for anything. ...I want to believe.
column2: ແຈ້ງເກີນ ສຳລັບໄຟທາງ Brandt. ແຈ້ງເກີນ ສຳລັບທຸກຢ່າງ. ...ຂ້ອຍຢາກເຊື່ອ.
ອອກນອກອາຄານ

column1: Pictures that leave by cable or network, skapi, not only a window on a screen. Press START.
column2: ຮູບທີ່ອອກທາງສາຍ ຫຼື ທາງເຄືອຂ່າຍ skapi ບໍ່ແມ່ນພຽງໜ້າຕ່າງເທິງຈໍ. ກົດ START.

column1: NDI over the network, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: NDI ທາງເຄືອຂ່າຍ, SDI ຈາກບັດ DeckLink, ST 2110 ສຳລັບສະຖານີອອກອາກາດ.
ໜ້າອຸປະກອນ

column1: MENU, Video Outputs, then Devices: every way an output can leave this computer.
column2: ເມນູ, Video Outputs ແລ້ວ ອຸປະກອນ: ທຸກທາງ ທີ່ output ອອກຈາກເຄື່ອງນີ້ໄດ້.

column1: Each one says whether this machine can do it, and what it needs if not.
column2: ແຕ່ລະອັນບອກວ່າ ເຄື່ອງນີ້ເຮັດໄດ້ບໍ ແລະ ຖ້າບໍ່ ຕ້ອງການຫຍັງ.

column1: If this computer has NDI, switch NDI SENDING on: the picture is on the network. If not, SHOW ME moves on.
column2: ຖ້າເຄື່ອງນີ້ມີ NDI ເປີດ NDI SENDING: ຮູບຢູ່ໃນເຄືອຂ່າຍແລ້ວ. ຖ້າບໍ່ SHOW ME ໄປຕໍ່.

column1: NDI finds itself on the network. No cables, only a good switch and patience.
column2: NDI ຊອກພົບຕົວເອງ ໃນເຄືອຂ່າຍ. ບໍ່ມີສາຍ ພຽງ switch ດີໆ ແລະ ຄວາມອົດທົນ.
ຂ້າງນອກ

column1: The output's own page has the rest: a DeckLink card's SDI, ST 2110 with NMOS, Spout and Syphon.
column2: ໜ້າ output ມີອັນອື່ນອີກ: SDI ຂອງບັດ DeckLink, ST 2110 ກັບ NMOS, Spout ແລະ Syphon.

column1: Every one is just an output. The show does not know or care how it leaves.
column2: ແຕ່ລະອັນ ເປັນພຽງ output. ໂຊບໍ່ຮູ້ ແລະ ບໍ່ສົນ ວ່າມັນອອກແນວໃດ.
ເນບິວລາ ຂ້າງໜ້າ
ຫ້ອງເຄື່ອງຈັກ
ຊັ້ນ 3: ມີຫຍັງເຄື່ອນໄຫວ
ຫ້ອງບັນຊາການ

column1: The bridge of the starship Cathode, skapi. Four feeds, one main viewer, one mystery. Press START.
column2: ຫ້ອງບັນຊາການຂອງຍານ Cathode skapi. ສີ່ feed ຈໍຫຼັກ ຄວາມລັບ. ກົດ START.

column1: The multiview shows every playlist at once. Like a wall of oscilloscopes, but in space.
column2: Multiview ສະແດງທຸກ playlist ພ້ອມກັນ. ຄືຝາ oscilloscope ແຕ່ຢູ່ໃນອະວະກາດ.

column1: Frequencies open, Captain. All of them. That's the problem.
column2: ທຸກຄວາມຖີ່ເປີດຢູ່ ກັບຕັນ. ທັງໝົດ. ນັ້ນແຫຼະບັນຫາ.

column1: MULTI, above the monitor: every playlist in its own window.
column2: MULTI ເທິງຈໍ: ແຕ່ລະ playlist ໃນໜ້າຕ່າງຂອງຕົນ.

column1: One window per playlist, the programme first.
column2: ໜ້າຕ່າງສຳລັບແຕ່ລະ playlist, program ກ່ອນ.

column1: Jinkys! Four feeds. And one of them has a monster in it.
column2: Jinkys! ສີ່ feed. ແລະ ອັນໜຶ່ງມີສັດປະຫຼາດ.
ຕໍ່ໄປແມ່ນຫຍັງ

column1: Add a window (+), then its ... menu: make it show NEXT. What goes live when you press TAKE.
column2: ເພີ່ມໜ້າຕ່າງ (+) ແລ້ວເມນູ ... ຂອງມັນ: ສະແດງ NEXT. ສິ່ງທີ່ຈະຂຶ້ນສົດ ເມື່ອເຈົ້າກົດ TAKE.

column1: Every window has a ... button. It chooses what that window shows.
column2: ທຸກໜ້າຕ່າງ ມີປຸ່ມ .... ມັນເລືອກວ່າ ໜ້າຕ່າງນັ້ນສະແດງຫຍັງ.

column1: I need to see who's calling before they reach the main viewer.
column2: ຂ້ອຍຕ້ອງເຫັນວ່າໃຜໂທມາ ກ່ອນເຂົາຮອດຈໍຫຼັກ.
ໂມງ

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late. Mostly.
column2: ແລະ ອີກໜ້າຕ່າງໜຶ່ງ ສະແດງໂມງ. ຜູ້ຄວບຄຸມທີ່ເບິ່ງໂມງ ບໍ່ເຄີຍຊ້າ. ສ່ວນຫຼາຍ.

column1: Time of day, big. Stardates are just very long timecode.
column2: ເວລາຂອງມື້ ໃຫຍ່ໆ. Stardate ເປັນພຽງ timecode ທີ່ຍາວຫຼາຍ.

column1: The monster only shows up at midnight. We're going to need a clock.
column2: ສັດປະຫຼາດ ປາກົດຕອນທ່ຽງຄືນເທົ່ານັ້ນ. ພວກເຮົາຕ້ອງມີໂມງ.
ອັນໃຫຍ່

column1: Any window's ... menu, then a layout: one big, the rest small.
column2: ເມນູ ... ຂອງໜ້າຕ່າງໃດກໍໄດ້ ແລ້ວ layout: ອັນໜຶ່ງໃຫຍ່ ທີ່ເຫຼືອນ້ອຍ.

column1: The big window is window one. Usually the programme. Usually.
column2: ໜ້າຕ່າງໃຫຍ່ ແມ່ນໜ້າຕ່າງທີໜຶ່ງ. ປົກກະຕິແມ່ນ program. ປົກກະຕິ.

column1: Main viewer big. The captain likes it big.
column2: ຈໍຫຼັກ ໃຫຍ່. ກັບຕັນມັກໃຫຍ່.
ຂຶ້ນຈໍ

column1: Select Deck 3 in playlist 3 and TAKE. Watch its window.
column2: ເລືອກ ຊັ້ນ 3 ໃນ playlist 3 ແລ້ວ TAKE. ເບິ່ງໜ້າຕ່າງຂອງມັນ.

column1: The red border is TALLY: the window that is on air. On screen, as they say on starships.
column2: ຂອບແດງ ແມ່ນ TALLY: ໜ້າຕ່າງທີ່ສົດຢູ່. ຂຶ້ນຈໍ ຄືທີ່ເຂົາເວົ້າໃນຍານ.

column1: There! Feed three! Put it on screen!
column2: ນັ້ນ! feed ສາມ! ເອົາຂຶ້ນຈໍ!
ຈົບງານ

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved, skapi.
column2: ໜ້າຕ່າງ ເມນູ ... NEXT ໂມງ layout tally. ຄວາມລັບຖືກແກ້ແລ້ວ skapi.

column1: A window can also show an output, with its warp and slices. Handy when it's a lighthouse.
column2: ໜ້າຕ່າງ ສະແດງ output ກໍໄດ້ ພ້ອມ warp ແລະ slice ຂອງມັນ. ມີປະໂຫຍດ ເມື່ອເປັນເຄື່ອງສາຍ.

column1: And the monster was... the ship's cook, all along. Jinkys.
column2: ແລະ ສັດປະຫຼາດ... ແມ່ນພໍ່ຄົວຂອງຍານ ມາຕະຫຼອດ. Jinkys.
ບໍ່ມີບົດຮຽນແບບນັ້ນ

column1: finish or leave the lesson you are in first
column2: ຈົບ ຫຼື ອອກຈາກບົດທີ່ຮຽນຢູ່ກ່ອນ
ອອກຈາກ Bug Swat ກ່ອນ

column1: Psst. It's me, the desk. I'll be watching. Supportively.
column2: ຊູ່ວ. ຂ້ອຍເອງ ໂຕະ. ຂ້ອຍຈະເບິ່ງ. ເພື່ອໃຫ້ກຳລັງໃຈ.

column1: Hi! I'm the one doing all of this, by the way.
column2: ສະບາຍດີ! ເວົ້າແທ້ ຂ້ອຍເຮັດທຸກຢ່າງນີ້ເອງ.

column1: Ctrl+D opens the DASH. I'm just saying.
column2: Ctrl+D ເປີດ DASH. ບອກໄວ້ຊື່ໆ.

column1: Nearly there. I can feel it in my pixels.
column2: ເກືອບແລ້ວ. ຂ້ອຍຮູ້ສຶກໄດ້ ໃນ pixel ຂອງຂ້ອຍ.

column1: You're good at this. I can tell. I'm the one doing it.
column2: ເຈົ້າເກັ່ງເລື່ອງນີ້. ຂ້ອຍເຫັນ. ແທ້ໆ.

column1: Every click, I heard. Every single one.
column2: ທຸກຄລິກ ຂ້ອຍໄດ້ຍິນ. ທຸກອັນ.

column1: The glowing one. I can see it from here. It's glowing for you.
column2: ອັນທີ່ເຫຼື້ອມ. ຂ້ອຍເຫັນຈາກນີ້. ມັນເຫຼື້ອມໃຫ້ເຈົ້າ.

column1: lesson paused - MENU > LESSONS picks up where you left off
column2: ບົດຮຽນພັກ - ເມນູ > LESSONS ສືບຕໍ່ຈາກບ່ອນທີ່ເຈົ້າຢຸດ

column1: PROF. VIDEO:  The signal: what the picture is made of, and how to bend it. Pick a lesson.

column1: Bugs are crawling to the cue list! Swat them by waving at your camera. First, Motion: in MOTION CONTROL turn it ON and choose what it READS.
column2: ແມງໄມ້ ກຳລັງຄານໄປຫາລາຍການ cue! ໂບກມືໃສ່ກ້ອງ ເພື່ອຕີມັນ. ກ່ອນອື່ນ Motion: ເປີດ ON ໃນ MOTION CONTROL ແລ້ວເລືອກວ່າມັນອ່ານຫຍັງ (READS).

column1: This one is NullPointer. Hollow, points at nothing. A finger goes straight through. Use the whole hand, skapi.
column2: ນີ້ແມ່ນ NullPointer. ມັນຫວ່າງ ບໍ່ຊີ້ໄປໃສ. ນິ້ວມືທະລຸຜ່ານ. ໃຊ້ທັງມື skapi.

column1: Wave like you are hailing a cab! A small, polite cab. Not the buttons. The cab.
column2: ໂບກຄືເອີ້ນລົດແທັກຊີ! ແທັກຊີນ້ອຍໆ ສຸພາບ. ບໍ່ແມ່ນປຸ່ມ. ແທັກຊີ.
ແຕ້ມສອງເຂດ

column1: Race Condition: twins, each sure it got there first. One reading cannot tell your hands apart, so drag two ZONES on the Motion picture, one each side.
column2: Race Condition: ຄູ່ແຝດ ແຕ່ລະໂຕໝັ້ນໃຈວ່າມາຮອດກ່ອນ. ການອ່ານດຽວ ແຍກມືເຈົ້າບໍ່ໄດ້ ສະນັ້ນລາກສອງ ZONES ເທິງຮູບ Motion ແຕ່ລະຂ້າງອັນໜຶ່ງ.

column1: Hit both together. Hit one, and they swap. Like my cousins at a wedding.
column2: ຕີທັງສອງພ້ອມກັນ. ຕີອັນດຽວ ພວກມັນສັບບ່ອນ. ຄືພີ່ນ້ອງຂອງຂ້ອຍ ໃນງານແຕ່ງ.

column1: One hand each side. Together! Together!
column2: ມືໜຶ່ງແຕ່ລະຂ້າງ. ພ້ອມກັນ! ພ້ອມກັນ!

column1: Off By One. The bug is not the face, it is the tiny extra segment, and a little wiggle needs a finer reading. Turn SENSITIVITY down to 5%.
column2: Off By One. ແມງໄມ້ ບໍ່ແມ່ນໜ້າ ແຕ່ແມ່ນທ່ອນນ້ອຍທີ່ເກີນ ແລະ ການຂະຫຍັບນ້ອຍ ຕ້ອງອ່ານລະອຽດຂຶ້ນ. ຫຼຸດ SENSITIVITY ລົງເປັນ 5%.

column1: Lower number, finer reading. Yes, I also think it is backwards.
column2: ເລກຕ່ຳ ອ່ານລະອຽດ. ແມ່ນ ຂ້ອຍກໍຄິດວ່າມັນປີ້ນ.

column1: Not the face. The little one on the end. Wiggle a finger.
column2: ບໍ່ແມ່ນໜ້າ. ອັນນ້ອຍທ້າຍສຸດ. ຂະຫຍັບນິ້ວໜຶ່ງ.
FALL 1.5 S ຫຼື ຫຼາຍກວ່າ

column1: Memory Leak. It only lets go while the reading stays up. Make FALL longer, 1.5 seconds or more, so your sweeps join up into one.
column2: Memory Leak. ມັນປ່ອຍ ເມື່ອການອ່ານຍັງສູງເທົ່ານັ້ນ. ຍືດ FALL ໃຫ້ຍາວ 1.5 ວິນາທີ ຫຼື ຫຼາຍກວ່າ ໃຫ້ການຕີເປັນອັນດຽວ.

column1: Slow and steady, skapi. Like paying back a loan.
column2: ຊ້າແຕ່ໝັ້ນ skapi. ຄືຈ່າຍໜີ້.

column1: Sweep, and sweep again. Let the fall carry you between.
column2: ກວາດ ແລ້ວກວາດອີກ. ໃຫ້ການຫຼຸດລົງ ຮັບເຈົ້າໄວ້ລະຫວ່າງ.
MOTION X ເທິງສຽງ

column1: The Heisenbug! It fades whenever you move. Put a tone cue's pitch on Motion X and follow it by ear: the ticking speeds up as you close in.
column2: Heisenbug! ມັນຈາງທຸກເທື່ອ ທີ່ເຈົ້າເຄື່ອນ. ເອົາລະດັບສຽງຂອງ cue ສຽງ ໃສ່ Motion X ແລ້ວຕາມດ້ວຍຫູ: ໃກ້ເຂົ້າ ສຽງຕິກໆ ໄວຂຶ້ນ.

column1: SHOW ME makes the tone for you. High is right. Low is left. Stand still and it comes back.
column2: SHOW ME ສ້າງສຽງໃຫ້ເຈົ້າ. ສູງ ແມ່ນຂວາ. ຕ່ຳ ແມ່ນຊ້າຍ. ຢືນນິ່ງ ມັນກັບມາ.

column1: Follow it. Listen. Faster ticking, closer bug.
column2: ຕາມມັນ. ຟັງ. ຕິກໆ ໄວຂຶ້ນ ແມງໄມ້ໃກ້ຂຶ້ນ.
ມືທີ່ໂບກ
ເຄື່ອງກວດ Heisenbug
ແກ້ແລ້ວ! ສາຍສັນຍານງາມ.

column1: Closed as fixed. No regressions. Probably.
column2: ປິດວ່າແກ້ແລ້ວ. ບໍ່ກັບມາ. ບາງທີ.
ຕີແຕກ! ສົ່ງອອກໄປ.

column1: One reached the cue list. It has filed a bug report about you.
column2: ໂຕໜຶ່ງ ໄປຮອດລາຍການ cue. ມັນສົ່ງລາຍງານຂໍ້ຜິດພາດ ກ່ຽວກັບເຈົ້າ.

column1: Skapi. It is a handheld. You do not press it. You wave at it.
column2: Skapi. ນີ້ແມ່ນເຄື່ອງມືຖື. ເຈົ້າບໍ່ກົດມັນ. ເຈົ້າໂບກມືໃສ່ມັນ.

column1: The buttons are for menus. The bugs are for flailing.
column2: ປຸ່ມ ສຳລັບເມນູ. ແມງໄມ້ ສຳລັບໂບກແຂນ.

column1: The D-pad is decorative. Like my diploma.
column2: D-pad ແມ່ນເຄື່ອງປະດັບ. ຄືໃບປະກາດຂອງຂ້ອຍ.

column1: In 1989 we also pressed the buttons. Then we discovered waving. Never looked back.
column2: ປີ 1989 ພວກເຮົາກໍກົດປຸ່ມ. ແລ້ວພວກເຮົາພົບການໂບກ. ບໍ່ເຄີຍເຫຼືອບຫຼັງ.

column1: Pressing harder does not help. The bugs cannot feel buttons. Only arms.
column2: ກົດແຮງຂຶ້ນ ບໍ່ຊ່ວຍ. ແມງໄມ້ບໍ່ຮູ້ສຶກປຸ່ມ. ພຽງແຂນ.

column1: It's called a handheld because your hands are held... up. In the air. Waving.
column2: ເອີ້ນວ່າເຄື່ອງມືຖື ເພາະມື... ຍົກຂຶ້ນ. ໃນອາກາດ. ໂບກໆ.

column1: The mouse? You are swatting bugs with a MOUSE? In Bulgaria the mouse would be on the bugs' side.
column2: ເມົ້າບໍ? ເຈົ້າຕີແມງໄມ້ ດ້ວຍເມົ້າບໍ? ຢູ່ Bulgaria ເມົ້າຈະເຂົ້າຂ້າງແມງໄມ້.

column1: Lovely clicking. Very crisp. The camera saw none of it.
column2: ກົດງາມ. ແຮງຫຼາຍ. ກ້ອງບໍ່ເຫັນຈັກອັນ.
